question: On fresh generated 5x5 rules, does changing only the candidate side’s non-check qsearch stand-pat leaf evaluator from Unit material to the default static-v2 evaluator improve conservative finite-budget utility or robust search cost against a fixed Unit opponent?
changed_premise: A no-outcome one-root probe showed qsearch stand-pat leaf prices alone can change the selected root action while keeping main-search leaves and move ordering Unit. The prior probe had one root and no outcome evidence. The current runtime qsearch recurses through _quiescence_runtime; the isolated test wrapper must hold a q-leaf proxy across public quiescence recursion and restore Unit in finally.

arms.fixed_foe: Unit material leaves including qsearch; only candidate side differs between the two paired arms
arms.fixed_candidate_settings: Unit main-search leaves, Unit normal/main ordering; qsearch ordering disabled identically (default); same full alpha-beta configuration, complete rules/history and legal-action interface.

roots.physical_games: 8 generated rules x 2 openings x 2 candidate owners x 2 candidate q-leaf arms = 64
roots.selection: Use all generated seeds and prescribed roots. No outcome/exposure/cost filtering, seed replacement or top-up. Root prefix actions are only state construction; no post-search preflight action is submitted.

preflight.mode: Outcome-free, one search per arm for all 16 frozen roots; submit no searched action. Unit arm scores both Unit and static-v2 on each reached q-leaf state to measure same-input value divergence. Full panel uses all roots regardless of observed exposure, but only starts if at least 8 roots expose q-leaf calls in both arms and at least one same-state score difference.

cost.basis: The prior matched 64-game qsearch capture-order panel completed in about 66 seconds under the same depth/node/time/qnode ceilings. Static-v2 adds evaluator cost at q leaves; 900 seconds allows a >13x overhead allowance, while the frozen cap is 3600 seconds. One process, bounded searches, no training/solver.
cost.cheaper_alternative: If fewer than 8/16 roots pass no-outcome q-leaf exposure/divergence, stop with CLOSED_UNTESTED and publish preflight evidence only.

integrity: Freeze all 64 slots once. Keep promotion, drops/hands, auxiliary state, repetition and complete history; store legal actions and full records.
Preserve actual terminal results, cap/fallback/unfinished/UNKNOWN distinctions; UNKNOWN contributes independently [-1,+1] to conservative paired utility; never impute.
No training, no solver, no product/default source change; only test producer plus data/report.

Hash plan, producer, source and preflight. Verify root regeneration, matched root digests, legal actions and full-history replay. Stop polling if a role/project stop is activated; never alter stop flags.

retention.utility_gate: Conservative reward lower mean >0 in every preregistered view: overall, both candidate owners, 3/4-ply roots, candidate-first/reply, and all leave-one-rule-seed-out samples.
retention.cost_gate: Median paired node reduction >=10% overall, each owner and each root-ply stratum; no conservative utility lower mean <0 in any view; and static-q-leaf candidate total caller seconds <= Unit-q-leaf candidate total caller seconds.
retention.reward: For every exact matched root/owner, static arm interval minus Unit arm interval. Known W/D/L maps to +1/0/-1; any UNKNOWN paired comparison is [-1,+1] before subtraction.
retention.scope: No default/global price, population or strength claim; if neither gate passes, close this sampled q-leaf consumer.

pre_outcome_execution_amendment.reason: First preflight attempt failed before generation/search because rules.board_size was not explicit in JSON although the frozen question/roots specify 5x5. Add board_size=5; no arms, seeds, slots, search limits, outcomes or gates changed.

pre_outcome_execution_amendment_2.reason: Second preflight attempt searched a root but failed while hashing RuntimeSearchState. Add a stable composite q-leaf key that includes exact current position, the full runtime history witness chain, repetition-count snapshot, no-progress context, ply and runtime hash. No searched action was submitted and outcomes_collected remains 0; the intervention and 64-slot protocol are unchanged.

pre_outcome_execution_amendment_3.reason: Third no-outcome preflight failure was a false positive in its guard: GameSession.history is a tuple, but the harness snapshotted list(session.history) and then compared the tuple to that list, which is always unequal despite identical contents. A one-root before/after diagnostic found state, position, history contents, result and search-history witnesses unchanged after choose_action. The guard now snapshots/compares tuples and emits field-specific changes if a genuine mutation occurs. No action was submitted and no outcomes were collected; arms, seeds, slots, budgets and gates are unchanged.
